content: Jessica, two of our HSU-KC jazz majors would be a strong fit for the Crossroads scholarship masterclass. Can we lock in observation slots before the semester ramps up?
Yes, let's get them in. I can host Tuesday afternoons before ensemble rehearsal. Send me their names and instruments and I'll set up the studio.
The scholarship recital will run as part of the December holiday recital at The Phoenix. I'll reserve two HSU-KC student slots in the program. Claire is coordinating RSVPs.
Program drafts are in the shared folder. I've added the HSU-KC students to the recital roster and confirmed the venue contact at The Phoenix for the December date.
The district arts office approved the spring jazz workshop series at three middle schools. We'd love Crossroads instructors to lead the sessions.
Happy to lead the workshops. I can bring two instructors and a small ensemble. Let's target late February so it doesn't collide with recital season.
Workshop dates confirmed: Feb 10, Feb 17, Feb 24. Each school can host 30 students. I'll send instrument inventory and load-in details for each site.
Jessica, the music department approved your spring guest clinic series. Dates confirmed: Jan 21, Feb 18, March 18. Please send a bio and headshot for the arts calendar.
Quick update: HSU-KC student bios are live on the recital page, the district workshop dates are locked, and the scholarship masterclass starts next Tuesday. Thanks all.
Looks great. I'll have the two students prepared for the masterclass and bring charts for the recital set. See everyone Tuesday.
